name: Hybrid pool-discovery (distributor + end-user)
description: Build #4 of the methodology harness. At ingestion, capture the candidate distributor + end-user pools as hypotheses (the idea card already has `distributor`; add `end_user_pool`). The /office-hours forcing questions (promoted from ad-hoc to a MANDATORY ingestion gate — also wires the long-stubbed `office-hours` slot in pipeline_gates) drive the dialogue half. The evidence half composes @caistech/brave-search (does a population of these operators/users exist + is it reachable?) + @caistech/ai-client (an LLM assesses, REJECTS weak pools, and PROPOSES better-fit ones with rationale — a back-and-forth, not one-shot). The agreed pools become the LLM-derived ICP + search query that pre-fills / auto-creates BOTH InvestorPilot streams — replacing today's operator-typed ICP + IP's raw 180-char-truncated Brave query. Compose, don't build bespoke (decision locked 2026-05-27).

env_vars.name: GITHUB_PACKAGES_TOKEN
env_vars.description: read:packages token to install @caistech/brave-search + @caistech/ai-client (+ optionally @caistech/hunter-email) from GitHub Packages (consumed as NODE_AUTH_TOKEN by .npmrc).

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env_vars.description: The LLM (via @caistech/ai-client) that assesses pool hypotheses against the gathered evidence, rejects weak pools, proposes better-fit ones, and derives the validated ICP + the Brave search query handed to InvestorPilot.

env_vars.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
env_vars.description: @caistech/brave-search — gathers supporting/contradicting evidence that a candidate distributor archetype / end-user segment is a real, reachable population (the 'is this pool real?' half).

env_vars.name: HUNTER_API_KEY
env_vars.description: @caistech/hunter-email — optional reachability signal (are contactable people findable in this pool). IP already does deep enrichment at activation, so the cockpit pre-validation can run without it; include only if we want a reachability score pre-launch.

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
env_vars.description: App public URL — already present; used for callbacks/links if the discovery step surfaces results back to the card.

external_setup.title: Install the @caistech discovery packages (consume the hub, never fork)
external_setup.description: The evidence half reuses the hub primitives InvestorPilot already uses (braveWebSearch / findContactByDomain) rather than re-implementing them.
steps: From the project root: npm install @caistech/brave-search @caistech/ai-client --legacy-peer-deps  (add @caistech/hunter-email only if pre-launch reachability scoring is wanted).
Confirm the fork-check stays clean (preflight runs check-shared-forks.mjs) — do NOT vendor a local braveWebSearch.

external_setup.title: Brave Search API key (harvest from the portfolio if it already exists)
external_setup.description: InvestorPilot already uses Brave for discovery, so a portfolio Brave key likely exists — harvest it rather than minting a new one.
steps: Check siblings: node ~/PycharmProjects/cais-shared-services/scripts/harvest-secrets.mjs --dry-run (looks for BRAVE_API_KEY across the portfolio).
If found, harvest it to this project's .env.local + Vercel; if not, mint one at the Brave API dashboard and set it local + Vercel (sensitive, prod+preview).
Verify @caistech/brave-search can call it with a smoke query before wiring the discovery flow.

external_setup.title: Promote /office-hours to the mandatory ingestion dialogue (the 'dialogue half')
external_setup.description: The /office-hours six forcing questions (demand reality / status quo / desperate specificity / narrowest wedge / observation / future-fit) produce the distributor + end-user pool hypotheses at intake. Promoting it from ad-hoc to a required step also wires the long-stubbed `office-hours` slot in pipeline_gates (recorded via gate-check.mjs).
steps: Decide where the dialogue runs: the /office-hours skill (CLI/session) producing the pool hypotheses + design doc, vs porting its question framework into the cockpit ingestion flow (likely voice-clarifier-driven).
Capture the agreed pools on the card (idea_card.distributor + new idea_card.end_user_pool).
Record the office-hours PASS in pipeline_gates (gate-check.mjs record <slug> office-hours pass --artifact <design-doc>).
